fields.description: The delivery bot's Telegram token. Used for klik_pos's own direct outbound sends (driver-approved DM, booklet-stalled alert - Phase 8) and Telegram media downloads (Phase 6). Same bot/value as the Worker's BOT_TOKEN secret - kept in sync by hand, not pushed automatically.
fields.label: Bot Token

fields.description: Cloudflare account id (from the Cloudflare dashboard), scoping the KV namespace below.
fields.label: Cloudflare Account ID

fields.description: Cloudflare API token with the 'Workers KV Storage: Edit' permission (a scoped API Token, not a Global API Key) - confirmed 2026-08-04 this permission is account-wide, Cloudflare has no finer per-namespace grain, so this token can write any KV namespace on the account, not only DRIVERS. Used to PUT the approved-driver list on every relevant Delivery Driver save.
fields.label: Cloudflare API Token

fields.description: The Worker's DRIVERS KV namespace id (from `wrangler kv namespace create`, or the Cloudflare dashboard). The push target key within it is always `drivers:approved`.
fields.label: Cloudflare KV Namespace ID (DRIVERS)

fields.description: Telegram chat id the Worker forwards each completed delivery to (summary text, photos, voice note - for human review). A supergroup's id is negative, e.g. -1001234567890. Leave blank to disable forwarding. Pushed to the same DRIVERS KV namespace above under key `config:reporting`, read by src/klikpos/config.ts - not a live klik_pos call from the Worker.
fields.label: Reporting Chat ID

fields.description: Optional - if the group above has Topics enabled and you want reports in one specific topic rather than General, its message_thread_id.
fields.label: Reporting Topic ID

fields.description: Comma-separated Telegram user ids to DM for things that need a human's attention: a permanent (422) delivery-report ingestion failure (Phase 5), and later (Phase 8) driver-approval and booklet-stalled alerts. Same convention as the old bot's ADMIN_TELEGRAM_IDS env var. Sent via klik_pos.api.telegram_notify.send_admin_alert.
fields.label: Admin Telegram IDs
